name: Almaty
summary: Almaty, Kazakhstan's largest city and former capital, sits at the foot of the Trans-Ili Alatau Mountains, with direct access to hiking, skiing (Shymbulak) and Big Almaty Lake. The cost of living is low and the cafe and coworking scene is growing rapidly along with the country's technological ecosystem. The main drawback is air pollution in winter due to thermal inversion, in addition to a notable language barrier (Russian and Kazakh dominate) and a clearly lower perceived safety at night than during the day.
